Alerting: Enforce provenance permissions via service-layer validator in notification APIs (#121335)

- introduce a new provenance transition validation logic that allows all transitions for whoever has permissions. Exception is `none-none` - it does not require permissions, and `prometheus_converted` - it's not allowed in any transition.
- update APIs to not return provenance annotation if status is `none`. 
- update alerting notifications domain services to support setting provenance via annotation. Now users can set the annotation.

commit.message:
Alerting: Add access control for managed routes (#121034)

* wire access control service to route service and API authz
* update alerting roles
- legacy permissions moved to hidden roles to keep access the default route for Viewer and Editor basic roles.
- fixed roles now use the new scoped permissions and they are granted to Admin only
This way, after upgrade basic roles will always keep the permissions to the default route, while permissions to the new managed routes will be granted via managed roles, which could be revoked. At the same time, the semantics of the fixed roles that grant wildcard access to the resource is kept the same.

* assert Forbidden error on non-existing resource because admin only can read all
* add test cases for legacy routes permissions
* set provisioning service to use proper authz service

* add migration to grant access to default route for basic roles

* set permissions on create and remove on delete

* remove legacy route permissions from fixed and basic roles

* set route permissions when alertmanager config is initialized

commit.message:
Alerting: Fix apiVersion for list items on k8s API's (#121204)

We've promoted the alerting.notifications API's to v1beta1, adding conversion functions for bi-directional conversion of v0alpha1 <-> v1beta1. We did that using unsafe pointers as the memory layout of the schemas are the same.

For list endpoints, however, there's a subtle bug. The list envelope is correctly set to the apiVersion that gets
called, but the list items will always be set to v1beta1 (since that's what legacy storage returns). This fixes it by recreating the items array and individually setting the `apiVersion` to the correct one

commit.message:
Alerting: Promote notifications.alerting.grafana.app resources to v1beta1 (#120738)

* alerting: promote notifications api's to v1beta1

* alerting: fix GetLegacyStorage panic for v0alpha1 notifications resources

GetLegacyStorage was matching on the full GVR (group + version + resource),
so requests for v0alpha1 resources would panic since ResourceInfo now points
to v1beta1. Since v0alpha1 is still a served (non-storage) version, the SDK
calls GetLegacyStorage for both versions.

Fix by switching to match on gvr.Resource only (ignoring version). This is
correct because legacy storage is backed by the domain service layer, not
tied to a specific API version _ the SDK handles v0alpha1_v1beta1 conversion
at the API layer before storage is invoked.

* generate snapshot

* generate FE clients

* register converters

* add converter for list types

* ignore unsafepointer linter complaints

* fix linter complaints

commit.message:
Alerting: Add backend support for named notification policies (#117061)

This PR introduces backend support for named notification policies in Grafana Alerting.

In addition to the existing single "user-defined" routing tree, notification policies can now 
be created and managed individually.

The feature is gated behind an experimental feature flag alertingMultiplePolicies. When the 
flag is disabled, the system behaves exactly as before and continues to expose a single 
legacy routing tree in APIs.

Alerting: Protected fields for Contact points (#115442)

* Alerting: Protect sensitive fields of contact points from
 unauthorized modification

- Introduce a new permission alert.notifications.receivers.protected:write. The permission is granted to contact point administrators.

- Update receiver service to enforce the permission and return status 403 if unauthorized user modifies protected field

Alerting: Support for active time intervals in notification policies (#104252)

* update k8s compat layer

* update notification policies service to validate active time intervals

* update openapi

* update api model

* update provisioning and export models

* update ui to allow active timing config

* update i18n

* fix snapshots for ui tests

* run prettier

* Alerting: Active time intervals UI naming (#104402)

* update naming in UI

* update naming in the edit page title

* update translations

* update alerting module
